what: A Path evidence bundle, and a receipt over it, recorded by nandatown before URL credentials were withheld. Both contain the fake credentials fixture-user:fixture-s3cret in plain text, which is the point: tests use them to check that Town withholds credentials when it displays or re-signs evidence it recorded earlier, without rewriting that evidence.
command: nandatown test-agent --url http://fixture-user:fixture-s3cret@127.0.0.1:<port> against the reference A2A agent behind basic authentication, then nandatown receipt <bundle>
credentials: fake, created for this fixture; they protect nothing
not: This is a test fixture. It is not an adoption, an endorsement, or evidence that anyone outside this repository ran Town.
